title: Ted Lasso Biscuits
creator: everydaypie

items.note: salted, softened, plus extra for the pan

steps: Heat the oven to 160 °C. Butter a 20 × 20 cm metal pan and line it with parchment, leaving an overhang.
Beat the butter until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Add the powdered sugar, vanilla and salt and beat for about 2 more minutes until very pale.
Add both flours and mix just until the dough comes together.
Press into the pan in an even layer, pushing into the corners and smoothing the top.
Bake for 45–55 minutes, until the edges are golden and the centre looks set and matte.
Cool completely in the pan, at least 2 hours, then lift out and cut into roughly 2.5 × 6 cm fingers.
Keeps 3–5 days in an airtight container.
